item.title: NITE Submit 1.0.0
item.description:
NITE Submit 1.0.0

  • Local PDF cover-sheet detection with UK and US university presets.
  • SHA-256 bit-identical original file preservation.
  • Real 7z LZMA2 archives with optional AES-256 password protection.
  • Lossless PDF size optimisation via bundled qpdf.
  • Local OCR for scanned PDFs (first few pages).
  • Anonymous marking identity policy checks.
